scenario.title: Agent lists and finds a space holding classic, SQL and composer charts; every link opens
scenario.prompt: Which charts are in the Emulator scenarios space?
expect: listContent items include Emulator space payments (chartSource composer, href /composer-charts/<uuid>), Emulator SQL payments (chartSource sql, href /sql-runner/emulator-sql-payments), Emulator classic payments (chartSource saved, href /saved/<uuid>/view) and the dashboard; no dashboard-owned composer chart
four chips: the classic chip opens the side preview, the SQL and composer chips open their pages, the dashboard chip opens the dashboard
readBack: the two tool results as stored

reply.text:
The Emulator scenarios space holds four items:

- [Emulator space payments](/projects/{{project}}/composer-charts/{{space_chart}})
- [Emulator SQL payments](/projects/{{project}}/sql-runner/emulator-sql-payments)
- [Emulator classic payments](/projects/{{project}}/saved/{{classic_chart}}/view)
- [Emulator dashboard](/projects/{{project}}/dashboards/{{dashboard}}/view)
